_comment: keyterms feed streaming socket keyterms_prompt to bias STT toward domain vocabulary — Application-of-Technology evidence

junior-frontend.text: Tell me about a time you debugged a tricky UI bug. What was the symptom, how did you isolate it, and what did you ship?
follow_ups: What tooling did you use to reproduce it?
How did you verify the fix didn't regress?

junior-frontend.text: Describe how you would build a reusable button component in React. What props and accessibility considerations would you include?
follow_ups: How would you handle variants like primary and secondary?
What tests would you write for it?

junior-frontend.text: Tell me about a time you had to learn a new frontend framework quickly. How did you approach it?
follow_ups: What was the hardest concept to grasp?
How did you validate your understanding?

junior-frontend.text: How would you optimize a page that loads slowly due to large images and many API calls?
follow_ups: How would you prioritize what to fix first?
What metrics would you track to confirm improvement?

junior-frontend.text: Imagine a designer hands you a Figma file with responsive layouts. How do you translate it into code?
follow_ups: How do you handle breakpoints that are not specified?
What do you do if the design lacks accessibility annotations?

junior-frontend.text: What would you do if your CSS change broke the layout on mobile but looked fine on desktop?
follow_ups: How would you reproduce the mobile issue locally?
How would you ensure the fix works across browsers?

junior-backend.text: Walk me through how you would design a rate limiter for a public API. What data structures and trade-offs would you consider?
follow_ups: How would you handle bursts vs sustained load?
Where would you store counters?
How would you test it under load?

junior-backend.text: Explain how you would design a simple REST API for a todo app. What endpoints and status codes would you use?
follow_ups: How would you handle authentication?
How would you version the API?

junior-backend.text: Tell me about a time you had to debug a production issue under time pressure. What steps did you take?
follow_ups: How did you communicate with stakeholders during the incident?
What did you do to prevent it from recurring?

junior-backend.text: How would you handle database migrations when deploying a schema change to production?
follow_ups: How would you handle rollback if the migration fails?
How do you test migrations without downtime?

junior-backend.text: If a downstream service you depend on goes down, how should your service respond?
follow_ups: How would you handle retries without overwhelming the downstream?
When would you show a fallback to the user?

junior-backend.text: Why did you choose backend development? What excites you about working on servers and data?
follow_ups: What backend concept are you most eager to deepen?
How do you stay motivated when work is invisible to users?

career-switcher.text: Tell me about your previous career and what motivated you to switch into software engineering?
follow_ups: What was the turning point that made you decide to switch?
How did you prepare for the transition?

career-switcher.text: Describe a transferable skill from your prior role that helps you as an engineer. Give a concrete example.
follow_ups: How did that skill help you on a recent project?
What skill are you still translating?

career-switcher.text: How would you approach learning a new programming language when you have a deadline?
follow_ups: What resources would you prioritize first?
How would you balance depth and speed?

career-switcher.text: Walk me through how you would explain a technical concept like APIs to a non-technical teammate.
follow_ups: How would you check that they actually understood?
What analogy would you use?

career-switcher.text: Tell me about a time you received tough feedback during your transition. How did you respond?
follow_ups: What did you change after receiving the feedback?
How do you solicit feedback now?

career-switcher.text: Imagine you're stuck on a bug for hours and no senior is available. What do you do next?
follow_ups: When would you escalate versus keep trying?
What debugging steps would you log before asking for help?
